name: book_appointment
description: Book a first appointment for a patient. Use the patient_id from create_patient/lookup_patient and the exact 'iso' value of the slot the caller chose from get_available_slots.
execution_message_description: Say a brief, natural reassurance that you're booking the appointment now.

patient_id.description: The patient_id (UUID) the appointment is for.

slot_iso.description: The chosen slot's 'iso' value returned by get_available_slots (ISO-8601 datetime).

reason.description: Optional short reason for the visit, e.g. 'New patient visit'.
